stories.title: Follow live: 49ers, Seahawks battle at Lumen Field
Texans trade for Cardinals' Harrison, reunite WR with QB Stroud
stories.summary: The Texans completed a trade for Cardinals wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr., coach DeMeco Ryans told reporters.

stories.title: Georgia new No. 1 in AP poll; Texas falls to 7, Ducks go unranked
stories.summary: Georgia moved to the No. 1 spot in the Week 7 AP Top 25 following its win at Alabama, while Oregon was unranked for the first time in four years after falling to 3-2.

stories.title: Eagles' Sirianni laments late-game call vs. Jags: 'I lost us that game'
stories.summary: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni took responsibility for his handling of the closing moments of Sunday's dramatic 19-17 loss to the Jaguars in London.

stories.title: Saleh to stick with Ward, give QB 'every opportunity' despite struggles
stories.summary: Robert Saleh said he'll stick with Cam Ward as his starting QB, even after the Tennessee offense had an embarrassing performance in a 26-3 loss to the Texans.
